---
title: 'Tailwind Configuration'
description: 'Integrate Reshaped themes with Tailwind CSS v4'
---

## Overview

Reshaped automatically generates Tailwind CSS v4 configuration files when you run the theming command. These files map Reshaped design tokens to Tailwind's utility classes.

## Generated Files

When you generate themes with the CLI, a `tailwind.css` file is created for each theme:

```
themes/
└── custom/
    ├── theme.css
    ├── theme.json
    └── tailwind.css    ← Tailwind configuration
```

## Tailwind CSS Output

The generated `tailwind.css` file uses Tailwind v4's `@theme` directive:

```css tailwind.css
@theme inline {
  /* Colors */
  --background-color-primary: var(--rs-color-background-primary);
  --background-color-secondary: var(--rs-color-background-secondary);
  --text-color-primary: var(--rs-color-foreground-primary);
  --text-color-on-primary: var(--rs-color-on-background-primary);
  --border-color-default: var(--rs-color-border-default);
  --outline-color-default: var(--rs-color-border-default);
  
  /* Spacing */
  --spacing-0: 0px;
  --spacing-x1: var(--rs-unit-x1);
  --spacing-x2: var(--rs-unit-x2);
  --spacing-x3: var(--rs-unit-x3);
  --spacing-x4: var(--rs-unit-x4);
  --spacing-x5: var(--rs-unit-x5);
  --spacing-x6: var(--rs-unit-x6);
  --spacing-x7: var(--rs-unit-x7);
  --spacing-x8: var(--rs-unit-x8);
  --spacing-x9: var(--rs-unit-x9);
  --spacing-x10: var(--rs-unit-x10);
  
  /* Radius */
  --radius-small: var(--rs-radius-small);
  --radius-medium: var(--rs-radius-medium);
  --radius-large: var(--rs-radius-large);
  
  /* Shadows */
  --shadow-small: var(--rs-shadow-small);
  --shadow-medium: var(--rs-shadow-medium);
  --shadow-large: var(--rs-shadow-large);
  
  /* Font Weight */
  --font-weight-regular: var(--rs-font-weight-regular);
  --font-weight-medium: var(--rs-font-weight-medium);
  --font-weight-bold: var(--rs-font-weight-bold);
  
  /* Breakpoints */
  --breakpoint-s: 0px;
  --breakpoint-m: 600px;
  --breakpoint-l: 1024px;
  --breakpoint-xl: 1440px;
}
```

## Token Mapping

Reshaped tokens are mapped to Tailwind utilities:

### Color Tokens

| Reshaped Token | Tailwind Variable | Utilities |
|----------------|-------------------|------------|
| `backgroundPrimary` | `--background-color-primary` | `bg-primary` |
| `foregroundPrimary` | `--text-color-primary` | `text-primary` |
| `onBackgroundPrimary` | `--text-color-on-primary` | `text-on-primary` |
| `borderDefault` | `--border-color-default`, `--outline-color-default` | `border-default`, `outline-default` |

### Spacing Tokens

| Reshaped Token | Tailwind Variable | Utilities |
|----------------|-------------------|------------|
| `x1` (0.25rem) | `--spacing-x1` | `p-x1`, `m-x1`, `gap-x1` |
| `x2` (0.5rem) | `--spacing-x2` | `p-x2`, `m-x2`, `gap-x2` |
| `x4` (1rem) | `--spacing-x4` | `p-x4`, `m-x4`, `gap-x4` |

### Radius Tokens

| Reshaped Token | Tailwind Variable | Utilities |
|----------------|-------------------|------------|
| `small` | `--radius-small` | `rounded-small` |
| `medium` | `--radius-medium` | `rounded-medium` |
| `large` | `--radius-large` | `rounded-large` |

### Shadow Tokens

| Reshaped Token | Tailwind Variable | Utilities |
|----------------|-------------------|------------|
| `shadowSmall` | `--shadow-small` | `shadow-small` |
| `shadowMedium` | `--shadow-medium` | `shadow-medium` |
| `shadowLarge` | `--shadow-large` | `shadow-large` |

## Setup

### 1. Generate Tailwind Configuration

Run the Reshaped CLI to generate theme files:

```bash
reshaped theming --output ./themes
```

### 2. Import in Your CSS

Import both the theme and Tailwind configuration:

```css app.css
@import '../themes/custom/theme.css';
@import '../themes/custom/tailwind.css';

@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;
```

### 3. Configure Tailwind

Create or update `tailwind.config.js`:

```js tailwind.config.js
/** @type {import('tailwindcss').Config} */
module.exports = {
  content: [
    './src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}',
    './pages/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}',
  ],
  // Theme variables are loaded from tailwind.css
};
```

## Usage Examples

### Using Generated Tokens

```tsx
function Card() {
  return (
    <div className="
      bg-primary 
      text-on-primary 
      p-x4 
      rounded-medium 
      shadow-medium
    ">
      Card content
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Responsive Design

```tsx
function Hero() {
  return (
    <div className="
      p-x2 m:p-x4 l:p-x6
      text-x4 l:text-x6
    ">
      Responsive hero section
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Custom Components

```tsx
function Button({ variant = 'primary' }) {
  return (
    <button className={`
      px-x4 py-x2
      rounded-medium
      font-weight-medium
      ${variant === 'primary' ? 'bg-primary text-on-primary' : 'bg-secondary text-primary'}
      hover:opacity-90
      transition-opacity
    `}>
      Click me
    </button>
  );
}
```

## Token Transformation

The transformation process (from `tailwind.ts:10-107`):

### Color Tokens

```js
// Input: backgroundPrimary
// Output: --background-color-primary

if (cssTokenName.startsWith('background-')) {
  const name = cssTokenName.replace('background-', '');
  variables[`--background-color-${name}`] = `var(--rs-color-${cssTokenName})`;
}
```

### On-Color Tokens

```js
// Input: onBackgroundPrimary
// Output: --text-color-on-primary

if (cssTokenName.startsWith('on-')) {
  const name = cssTokenName.replace('on-', '').replace('background-', '');
  variables[`--text-color-on-${name}`] = `var(--rs-color-${cssTokenName})`;
}
```

### Spacing Tokens

```js
// Input: unit.x1
// Output: --spacing-x1

Object.keys(definition.unit).forEach((tokenName) => {
  if (tokenName.startsWith('base')) {
    for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) {
      variables[`--spacing-x${i}`] = i === 0 ? '0px' : `var(--rs-unit-x${i})`;
    }
  }
});
```

## Multiple Themes

Switch between themes dynamically:

### Generate Multiple Themes

```js reshaped.config.js
export default {
  themes: {
    light: {
      color: {
        backgroundPrimary: { hex: '#ffffff' },
        foregroundPrimary: { hex: '#000000' },
      },
    },
    dark: {
      color: {
        backgroundPrimary: { hex: '#000000' },
        foregroundPrimary: { hex: '#ffffff' },
      },
    },
  },
};
```

### Import Both Themes

```css
@import '../themes/light/theme.css';
@import '../themes/light/tailwind.css';

[data-theme='dark'] {
  @import '../themes/dark/theme.css';
  @import '../themes/dark/tailwind.css';
}
```

### Toggle in React

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';

function App() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState('light');
  
  return (
    <div data-theme={theme}>
      <button onClick={() => setTheme(theme === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light')}>
        Toggle theme
      </button>
      <div className="bg-primary text-primary p-x4">
        Content adapts to theme
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Framework Integration

### Next.js

```js next.config.js
/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
module.exports = {
  // Next.js automatically processes PostCSS and Tailwind
};
```

```css app/globals.css
@import '../themes/custom/theme.css';
@import '../themes/custom/tailwind.css';

@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;
```

### Vite

```js vite.config.js
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';

export default defineConfig({
  css: {
    postcss: './postcss.config.js',
  },
});
```

```css src/index.css
@import '../themes/custom/theme.css';
@import '../themes/custom/tailwind.css';

@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;
```

## Advanced Customization

### Extending Tailwind Config

```js tailwind.config.js
module.exports = {
  content: ['./src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}'],
  theme: {
    extend: {
      // Add custom utilities beyond Reshaped tokens
      colors: {
        custom: '#ff00ff',
      },
    },
  },
};
```

### Custom Utilities

```css
@layer utilities {
  .card {
    @apply bg-primary rounded-medium shadow-medium p-x4;
  }
  
  .button-primary {
    @apply bg-primary text-on-primary px-x4 py-x2 rounded-medium;
  }
}
```

## Tailwind v4 Features

Reshaped's generated Tailwind configuration uses v4 features:

### @theme Directive

```css
@theme inline {
  --color-primary: #0066ff;
}
```

### CSS Variable Integration

Direct mapping to CSS custom properties:

```css
.bg-primary {
  background-color: var(--background-color-primary);
}
```
